items.item_text: Bachelor's Degree required; Master's or Post Graduate Degree preferred
12 years of relevant experience and 8 years of leadership experience
Strategic Financial Leadership: Develop and execute financial strategies, budgets, and long-term financial plans that align with the organization's mission and vision.
Financial Performance & Compliance: Oversee divisional financial performance, regulatory compliance, and ensure adherence to national targets and Enterprise policies.
Business Partnership & Collaboration: Act as a strategic business partner to divisional leadership, fostering collaboration with Enterprise finance teams and leveraging centralized resources.

Reporting & Governance: Represent the organization in financial affairs, presenting results and complex issues to boards and committees, while ensuring data transparency and professional business plans.
Strategic Growth & Development: Actively participate in the hospital's strategic planning and business development, providing high-level financial input for new programs and initiatives.
Operational Oversight: Provide financial oversight for key operational areas, including revenue cycle, managed care, supply chain, and joint venture arrangements.
Team Leadership: Lead and develop division finance teams, managing direct reports, and providing guidance for program development and strategic initiatives.
